verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a REST API with token/OAuth auth and versioning, plus an official npm SDK package (@rippling/rippling-sdk) referenced in developer docs. However, evidence is thin on SDK breadth (only Node/npm mentioned, no multi-language SDKs), no code samples, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK usability. Missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage, code examples/tutorials, independent developer confirmation of SDK quality.
